2197 Zacharias {dzakh-ar-ee'-as}

源自希伯來文 SNH02148; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Zacharias 11; 11

撒迦利亞 = "被耶和華紀念"
1) 施洗約翰的父親
2) 巴拉加的兒子
record.edic_text:
2197 Zacharias {dzakh-ar-ee'-as}

of Hebrew origin 02148;; n pr m

AV - Zacharias 11; 11

Zacharias meaning "remembered of Jehovah"
1) the father of John the Baptist
2) son of Barachias, who was slain by the Jews between the altar and
   the temple
